chunks: When, with (iron) collars and chains around their necks, they will be dragged

key_terms.السَّلَسِلُ: Chains, specifically those used for binding and dragging
key_terms.الْأَغْلَالُ: Shackles or heavy collars placed on the neck
key_terms.يُسْحَبُونَ: They are dragged or pulled along

ai.seo_question: What do the chains and shackles on the necks represent in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (40:72) is often interpreted as describing the physical manifestation of spiritual bondage, where the 'shackles' represent the weight of their own sins and the 'chains' symbolize the inescapable consequences of their denial. The dragging motion emphasizes the humiliation of those who were once proud, now forced to move slowly under the burden of their deeds, a concept echoed in the hadith of Imam Ali regarding the 'chains of deeds' that bind the soul. This imagery serves as a stark contrast to the freedom of the righteous, highlighting the causal link between earthly actions and eternal retribution.
